mentions.name: Don
mentions.description: Don is a work companion app that helps users set goals, reminds them to take breaks, checks in on how they feel, judges them when they go off track, and celebrates their accomplishments.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Don, a work companion.

Don helps you set goals.

Don reminds you to take breaks.

Don checks in how you fell.

Don judges you when you go off track.

Don celebrates you when you get stuff done.
